verdicts.reason: A centres the headline but left-aligns the CTA, so the two blocks don't share an axis. Its line break leaves 'sunshine.' alone on the second line, and the LIMITED badge has moved from before the button to after it, a different arrangement from the original. B keeps the original's centred composition and badge-plus-button pairing with a balanced two-line headline, but the headline sits too close to the top edge, leaving a lopsided empty band at the bottom, and the 'LIMITED' text on the badge is tiny.
